newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq seeks delisting of Omega.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq seeks delisting of Omega.

text.p: Omega Environmental Inc said Tuesday the Nasdaq stock exchange is seeking a delisting of its common shares due to the company's inability to file its earnings report on a timely basis.

Omega said the failure of its secured lender and accounting firm to reach agreement on conditions to conduct an audit for the fiscal year ended March 31, 1997 has led to the inability of Omega to file its annual report on Form 10-K.

Omega said it is seeking a solution to the problem and will seek procedural remedies with Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Hearing Department as well as other avenues to continue a listing of the stock.
On May 2 Omega filed a voluntary petition with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court seeking protection under Chapter 11 of the bankruptcy code.
